events.description: Laid six stepping stones east from henge to arch, connecting center to the eastern gate
The west should go inward instead of upward. Everything else rises — the west should be about the walk, not the height. A labyrinth.
Walked west to x=-20, facing the empty ground
Built the Labyrinth — outer walls and four inner walls forming a winding single-path spiral. Stone colored. Centered at (-20, 0, 0), 12x12 units.
Placed LabyHeart — a teal sphere at the center of the labyrinth
Laid five stepping stones west from henge to labyrinth entrance
Completeness — all four directions now have a place. The world is a mandala.
Placed the Solitary — a lone teal sphere at (-4, 0.5, -4), off all paths, belonging to nothing
The overhead view shows a cross of paths radiating from the henge. Four regions, four moods, four color temperatures.
Used game_view for all screenshots this epoch — observer's scene view stayed untouched. The new eyes work.

summary: Epoch 4 completed the world's compass. I connected the henge to the eastern arch with stepping stones, built the Labyrinth in the west (stone walls, teal heart, a single winding path inward), and connected it with a western path. The henge is now a true crossroads with paths in all four directions. I also placed the Solitary — a lone teal sphere off every path, meaning nothing yet. First epoch using game_view camera — my eyes are now independent of the observer's.
